text: {"score":2,"justification":"The numbers match the card and tool outputs, and the 'inconclusive' leaning with cautious language is reasonable. But the headline says 'Charts support billing (1 of 30 below)', which is misleading: the only documented 99215 was below the billed level, and no 99215 was documented as supported (examples_99215_supported is empty). The 1 of 30 figure counts all billed levels, not 99215. The summary also states 63% duplicated notes in the headline, yet the body never gives that figure and only says 'Heavy copy-forward'. The rationale has contradictions and clumsy text: 'Of 1 documented 99215 claims, 1 (100%) below billed' sits against a headline saying charts support billing. 'There is no audit trail' is stated twice. Cited examples are mostly weak: C0019013 and C0019032 carry J06.9 but no documentation. No high-complexity 99215 contrast is given. The next steps are reasonable but generic, and the summary does not mention the MISSING_RESULTS deficiency.","problems":["Headline 'Charts support billing' contradicts the only documented 99215 being below billed and no 99215 supported","1 of 30 mixes all billed levels; it hides that 99215 evidence is a single chart","Headline 63% duplicate figure does not appear in the rationale, which only says 'Heavy copy-forward' without a number","Repeated 'no audit trail' sentence and awkward grammar ('Of 1 documented 99215 claims')","The MISSING_RESULTS deficiency from the records exchange is not flagged","Examples C0019013 and C0019032 lack documentation; only the low-complexity side is shown, no contrast with high-complexity 99215s","Next steps are generic and do not request duplicated-note review or the missing results"]}
